description: This file defines mock classes for IWebAudioPlayer and IWebAudioPlayerFactory interfaces used in testing the WebAudioPlayer component within the Rialto project. It includes mock method declarations for simulating WebAudioPlayer behavior in unit tests.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerFactoryMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayerFactory interface, used to create mock WebAudioPlayer instances in tests.

classes.name: WebAudioPlayerMock
classes.description: Mock class for IWebAudioPlayer interface, providing mock implementations of audio playback methods for testing.

methods.name: createWebAudioPlayer
methods.description: Creates a mock WebAudioPlayer instance with specified client, MIME type, priority, and configuration.

methods.name: setEos
methods.description: Simulates setting end-of-stream for the audio.

methods.name: getBufferAvailable
methods.description: Retrieves available buffer frames and shared memory info.

methods.name: getBufferDelay
methods.description: Retrieves current buffer delay in frames.

methods.name: writeBuffer
methods.description: Writes audio data to the buffer.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information such as preferred and maximum frames, and support for deferred play.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Returns the client associated with the WebAudioPlayer.
